searches.query: PMID 41192117 abstract exact reported accuracy improvements

updates.производительность: The primary abstract reports an average accuracy improvement of 3.88% across 11 X-ITE sub-datasets and a 7.12% gain on the R-ETD sub-dataset; it does not specify percentage-point changes.
updates.ограничения: Only the primary abstract was accessible. Participant count, split unit, exact class definitions, absolute performance, confidence intervals, calibration and external validation were not established. X-ITE is an experimental-pain database; the word 'clinical' in the title does not establish clinical-outcome validation. The abstract gives the reported differences as 3.88% and a 7.12% gain, without specifying percentage-point changes.
